notes: Full absolute-coordinate ASME single-pendulum driven residual: each stage solves for right-Lie orientation increment, COM position/velocity/acceleration, body angular velocity/acceleration, pivot reaction force, axis multipliers, and drive multiplier. The square residual uses pivot velocity and pivot acceleration rows in the v027 PivotVA/FullVA style, plus ASME pivot position, two DP1 revolute-axis rows, and the acceleration-level DP1 drive row; drive position and velocity are reported as diagnostics.
